svg.title: How ctx| works
svg.desc: Connectors and linked code repositories commit Markdown to the Workspace repository, the source of truth. On each commit, ctx| rebuilds the search index, knowledge graph, and code search. Coding agents read through the MCP with seven read-only tools, and your team uses Workspace chat, an agent in an isolated sandbox. A self-learning loop sends pull requests back to the Workspace repository and merged lessons back to linked code.
